css: .t3-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t3-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.t3-head p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em}.t3-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:20px}.t3-head strong{font-size:12px;background:#e9eefb;color:#2647a2;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px}.t3-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,1.7fr) repeat(3,minmax(110px,1fr)) auto;gap:8px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:12px;min-width:0}.t3-controls label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:11px;color:#5f697b;min-width:0}.t3-controls input,.t3-controls select,.t3-controls button{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid #cfd6e2;background:white;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font:inherit;color:#1d2738}.t3-controls button{width:auto;cursor:pointer;font-weight:650;background:#172033;color:white;border-color:#172033;white-space:nowrap}.t3-table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:11px;background:white}.t3-table-wrap table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:510px}.t3-table-wrap th,.t3-table-wrap td{padding:9px 10px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f4}.t3-table-wrap th{font-size:11px;color:#657084;background:#f5f7fa;position:sticky;top:0}.t3-table-wrap tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}.t3-status{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;background:#eef1f5;font-size:11px}.t3-status[data-status="Doing"]{background:#fff3d6;color:#805700}.t3-status[data-status="Done"]{background:#e7f7ee;color:#176b3a}.t3-empty{padding:22px;text-align:center;color:#697386}@media(max-width:800px){.t3-controls{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.t3-controls button{width:100%}}
js: const search=root.querySelector('[data-search]');const status=root.querySelector('[data-status]');const owner=root.querySelector('[data-owner]');const sort=root.querySelector('[data-sort]');const clear=root.querySelector('[data-clear]');const rows=root.querySelector('[data-rows]');const count=root.querySelector('[data-count]');const empty=root.querySelector('[data-empty]');function safeDate(v){const n=Date.parse(v||'');return Number.isFinite(n)?n:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;}function refreshOwners(tasks){const prev=owner.value;const names=[...new Set(tasks.map(t=>t.owner).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b)));owner.innerHTML='<option value="">All owners</option>';names.forEach(name=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=name;o.textContent=name;owner.append(o);});if(names.includes(prev))owner.value=prev;}function filtered(tasks){const q=search.value.trim().toLowerCase();let list=tasks.filter(t=>(!q||String(t.title||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)||String(t.owner||'').toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!status.value||t.status===status.value)&&(!owner.value||t.owner===owner.value));const mode=sort.value;list.sort((a,b)=>{if(mode==='title-asc')return String(a.title||'').localeCompare(String(b.title||''));if(mode==='title-desc')return String(b.title||'').localeCompare(String(a.title||''));if(mode==='due-asc')return safeDate(a.due)-safeDate(b.due);return safeDate(b.due)-safeDate(a.due);});return list;}function render(){const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];refreshOwners(tasks);const list=filtered(tasks);count.textContent=list.length+' result'+(list.length===1?'':'s');rows.replaceChildren(...list.map(t=>{const tr=document.createElement('tr');const tdTitle=document.createElement('td');const tdOwner=document.createElement('td');const tdStatus=document.createElement('td');const tdDue=document.createElement('td');tdTitle.textContent=t.title||'(untitled)';tdOwner.textContent=t.owner||'—';const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='t3-status';badge.dataset.status=t.status||'';badge.textContent=t.status||'—';tdStatus.append(badge);tdDue.textContent=t.due||'—';tr.append(tdTitle,tdOwner,tdStatus,tdDue);return tr;}));empty.hidden=list.length!==0;}[search,status,owner,sort].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener(el===search?'input':'change',render));clear.addEventListener('click',()=>{search.value='';status.value='';owner.value='';sort.value='title-asc';render();});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
